m: Sixty feet of bar, scrubbed white. Big Tova slides a mug down it. It stops exactly where it should. It always does.
t: A table, carved all over with initials and teeth marks.
q: A barrel of KALDOR'S ALE. Over it, in Tova's hand: THE KING'S ALE. THE KING'S PRICE. YOUR ARM.
W: Tally on the wall: DAYS WITHOUT A BRAWL: 0. RECORD: 0.
1: The way out, to the bazaar.

objects.name: Big Tova
lines: Sit. Drink. Don't brawl on my good floor. Brawl on the other floor.
Tab's due, love. Arm or coin?

answer: Arm-wrestle me for it. Win, and the drink's free.
Nobody's won. Forty years. The horde owes me one hundred and eighty thousand drinks.
Sit down, love. It's on the house. It's always on the house, eventually.
Raiders off duty. Raiders on duty. Ulfa, who reads poems. Hekla, who wins.
Snorri, who's been asleep since the last war. I dust him on Sundays.
The Maximus has a new ladder. Five champions. Hroth's been top for forty years.
He's sick of it, between you and me. Drinks here every night. Wants somebody to beat him so he can retire.

objects.name: Ulfa the Skald
lines: A poem. 'Axe.' 'Axe.' 'Axe.' 'Axe.' 'Blood.'
…'Axe.'
Thank you. Thank you. It's called Tuesday.

objects.name: Great-Gran Hekla
lines: Arm-wrestle? Sit. I'm ninety-one. I haven't lost since I was ninety.
The year I was ninety I lost once. To Tova. We don't talk about it.

objects.name: Snorri
lines: Zzz… charge… zzz…
(He's been asleep since the last war. Tova says it's the best guard she's ever had.)

objects.name: Durn
lines: Eleven days. Over bread. Don't tell anybody.
HASKEL: Everybody knows, Durn. Bett told everybody.

objects.name: Haskel
lines: Best friends now. We fought for eleven days. That's basically a wedding here.

objects.name: Matron Sorrel
lines: You beat me fair. Rattle and all. I'm proud of you.
Now sit up straight and eat something. You look peaky.

objects.name: Fennick the Unbitten
lines: You caught me. Nobody catches me. I've been running for nine years.
My legs are very tired. Tova lets me sit here. I'm sitting. It's lovely.

objects.name: Hroth
lines: Forty years, champion. Then you.
I'm retiring. A little house. A garden. I'm going to grow one turnip and look at it.
Thank you. Truly. Buy you a drink? Tova says I can't. She says it's on the house.
In Tova's tip jar, under the coins: a Heart Piece.
'Somebody left it,' Tova says. 'Take it. You look like you'll need it.'
